description: This file defines the OrderStatus controller class in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages CRUD operations (list, create, update, delete) for order statuses within the admin interface, including rendering views, handling form submissions, and interacting with models and language files.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing order statuses in OpenCart admin panel, providing methods to list, create, edit, and delete order statuses.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the order status list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to refresh the order status list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the order status list, including pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an order status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of a new or existing order status via AJAX.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected order statuses, with permission and dependency checks.
